scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n WEB,SERVER -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev -w apps/web" "npm run dev -w apps/server"
scripts.build: npm run build -w apps/web && npm run build -w apps/server
scripts.test:e2e: playwright test tests/e2e/world3d.spec.ts tests/e2e/chelsea.spec.ts tests/e2e/arsenal.spec.ts tests/e2e/avatar-animation.spec.ts
scripts.format: prettier --write --ignore-unknown apps packages tests docs assets *.ts *.json *.yml *.md
